description: Angular component for a widgets bundle dialog in the Thingsboard UI, handling display, validation, and save operations for widget bundles.

classes.name: WidgetsBundleDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for the widget bundle dialog, managing form validation, user interactions, and communication with widget service.

methods.name: isErrorState

methods.description: Closes the dialog without saving changes.
